name: Cart Summary
summary: Passive target-controlled cart summary with native name/value rows, a canonical primary checkout Button, optional expectation note, and optional target-native express checkout composition.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named passive summary section controlled by the target.

anatomy.name: rows
anatomy.description: Native description list containing one coherent target snapshot.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Complete localized row name rendered as dt.

anatomy.name: value
anatomy.description: Complete target-formatted row value rendered as dd with direction isolation.

anatomy.name: note
anatomy.description: Concise target-authored checkout expectation or qualification.

anatomy.name: checkout
anatomy.description: Canonical primary checkout Button controlled by the target.

anatomy.name: divider
anatomy.description: Optional target-authored separator within the express composition.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size controlled by the parent container.

states.name: default
states.description: Available passive snapshot and checkout action.

states.name: checkoutDisabled
states.description: Target marks checkout unavailable with disabled and supplies a visible reason.

states.name: checkoutBusy
states.description: Canonical Button aria-busy plus disabled state prevents duplicate target activation while preserving its label.

states.name: compactContainer
states.description: Rows stack from their real parent width without changing DOM order.

behavior.name: associationList
behavior.description: Rows preserve native name/value relationships and mixed-direction target strings.

behavior.name: coherentSnapshot
behavior.description: The target supplies truthful rows from one cart snapshot and includes at least one total row.

behavior.name: checkoutAction
behavior.description: One canonical Button hands off to target form, router, SDK, or native checkout behavior.

behavior.name: expressComposition
behavior.description: The target/provider owns complete express action markup, accessible names, state and lifecycle; neutral source does not inspect provider internals.

behavior.name: parentPlacement
behavior.description: The parent target owns sticky placement, offset, scrolling and focus-obscuration avoidance; K3 itself is not sticky.

behavior.name: targetState
behavior.description: Target owns raw cart data, formatting, estimates, checkout request/result/error, provider availability, status cadence and focus.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Required semantic row composition containing at least one total dt/dd group.

properties.name: note
properties.description: Optional concise target-authored checkout expectation or qualification.

properties.name: checkoutLabel
properties.description: Required non-empty visible label for the primary checkout Button.

properties.name: checkoutDisabled
properties.description: Projects target-owned checkout unavailability to canonical Button disabled behavior.

properties.name: checkoutBusy
properties.description: Projects target-owned asynchronous checkout work to canonical Button busy and disabled behavior.

properties.name: express
properties.description: Optional opaque target-native express checkout composition.

accessibility: Use a visible heading and native dl, dt, and dd relationships; add no cart-summary widget role or live region.
Keep the primary checkout Button before optional express actions in DOM and focus order.
Disabled checkout requires a visible target explanation; busy checkout preserves its label and prevents duplicate activation.
Announce cart or checkout results once through a parent target status with complete context instead of making each value live.
Do not rely on target sticky placement as the only way to access checkout or allow it to obscure focused content.

web.notes: Named passive section, native association list, canonical Button and target-owned composition.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Liquid maps cart facts, named checkout submission and optional provider-owned accelerated checkout; runtime/editor/live-store proof remains required.
